title: Sector note frontmatter (v1)
description: Structural contract for findata/Sectors/<Name>.md YAML frontmatter (42 live notes, 2026-08-17).

title.description: Canonical CAPITALIZED sector name (matches directory name).

type.description: Note type discriminator — always 'sector' in Sectors/.

super_sector.description: Parent super-sector title; must reference a Super_Sectors/ note (relational check).

normalized_name.description: Filename-derived canonical name; matches filename minus .md.

isoDate.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD); PyYAML date objects are normalized before checking.
